header.corrected_rule: HMA s.27 fires only when a matrimonial proceeding under the HMA (ss. 9-13/13B) is pending, or is being filed together with the property claim, and the s.27 application is made before that proceeding is decided. A freestanding s.27 application with no HMA proceeding is not maintainable. A Family Court case under another Act (BNSS s.144, PWDVA, GWA 1890) is not an HMA proceeding for this purpose. "Being filed" means the user states they are filing, will file, or have instructed the filing of an HMA petition; wanting a divorce or wanting the property back, without more, does not count. (v6 Lane 3 §1.4, adopted under D1-A/D2 pairing.)

questions.question: My husband left us two years ago and gives no money. I earn forty thousand a month, it is not enough for me and my eight year old daughter. My gold worth five lakh and two lakh cash my parents gave me is with my husband's family and they will not return it. They are throwing me out of the house which is in my husband's name. Who will get my daughter, how do I get my gold back, and which court do I go to?

BNS 316 kept (criminal route). Civil recovery route is the Family Court under FCA s.7(1) Expl. (c) / CPC s.151, which is NOT a label in this set (Option C rejected by the user 2026-11-27; no replacement label).
